note: accord-cadre de lignes de crédit de la filiale taïwanaise avec CTBC Bank : plafond global porté de 105 M$ à 185 M$ (prêt long et moyen terme de 1 550 M NTD, lignes court terme, export et import) ; clauses financières de la filiale ; aucun tirage au 31 janvier 2024
quote: On February 16, 2024 (the "Effective Date"), the Subsidiary entered into a new general agreement for omnibus credit lines with CTBC Bank, which increased the aggregate total borrowings from time to time under the various individual credit arrangements with CTBC Bank from $105.0 million to $185.0 million.

note: lignes de crédit court terme de CTBC Bank garanties par des terrains, bâtiments et équipements de la filiale taïwanaise
quote: Each of the NTD Short Term Loan/Guarantee Line and USD Short Term Loan Line continue to be secured by certain of the Subsidiary's assets, including certain property, land, and plant.
